blocks.translation:
• Warning — Read this before use.
• This product is for ages 15 and older. Do not give it to children younger than the specified age.
• This product contains small parts. Keep it away from young children to prevent accidental swallowing and choking.
• This product has pointed or sharp parts. Handle and store it carefully to avoid unexpected injury.
• Do not use the product near the ear. Improper use near the ear may damage hearing.
• This product contains electronic components; people with pacemakers should take care.
• Do not play roughly, such as by hitting or swinging the product.
• Do not put fingers or other body parts into moving parts. They may become trapped and cause injury.
• Do not stare at the flashing LED lights. Continuous viewing may cause dizziness or other discomfort.
• Misuse of the built-in rechargeable battery can cause overheating, rupture, fire, or leakage. A short circuit allows a large current to flow and is dangerous. Avoid shorting the battery.
• Do not recharge a charged Shodowphon -MEMORIAL EDITION-. Recharging a charged battery can cause overcharge and is dangerous.
• Stop using the product immediately if it gets wet. Moisture can cause a short circuit.
• Do not immerse the product in water or fire, and do not disassemble or solder it.
• Do not use, charge, or store the product near fire or in high-temperature or high-humidity locations.
• When disposing of the product, follow your local municipality's waste-disposal instructions.

blocks.translation:
• This product is precision-made. Applying excessive force or dropping it may cause damage.
• This product contains delicate electronic components. Do not drop it, get it wet, soil it, or disassemble it. Also avoid using or storing it in places that become very hot or very cold.

• Do not place this product on resin (plastic) sofas, seats, tiles, or similar surfaces. Prolonged contact may cause color transfer.
